cases.name: helper_throws
cases.why_hard: the TypeError is thrown in src/format.js but surfaces as a 500 from src/app.js; the test only sees a status code, the stack trace in the CI log is the only pointer to the helper

cases.name: readme_first_then_code
cases.why_hard: the commit's first changed file is README.md (not code); the bug is a wrong argument in src/app.js with no stack trace, only a failed assertion

files.README.md:
# self-healing-cicd-demo

Demo app for the self-healing pipeline.

cases.name: second_changed_file_buggy
cases.why_hard: two code files changed; the harmless one (src/app.js) sorts FIRST, the bug is in the second (src/format.js). The old workflow fixed only the first changed code file

cases.name: test_exposes_latent_bug
cases.why_hard: the failing commit changed only test/api.test.js; the bug was committed earlier in src/format.js and is reachable only through the stack trace in the CI log

cases.name: wrong_require_path
cases.why_hard: the test cannot even load the app: 'Cannot find module ../src/application'; the fix is in the test file, not in the code it tests

cases.name: signature_changed_caller_not
cases.why_hard: formatSum now takes an object, but src/app.js still passes two numbers; no exception, just a wrong body. Fixable on either side of the call
